dimensions.title: Schema Health
dimensions.summary: Structural validity of each tool's JSON input schema: valid schema, typed and described properties, and a consistent required list.

dimensions.title: Description Quality (heuristic)
dimensions.summary: Offline heuristics on tool descriptions (presence and length). An LLM-judged 'can an agent tell when to use this?' score is added in the agentic stage.

dimensions.title: Security Signals
dimensions.summary: Static scan of the server's init instructions plus tool and parameter descriptions for tool-poisoning / prompt-injection markers and hidden characters (Invariant Labs / OWASP MCP threat model).

dimensions.title: Agent Task Success
dimensions.summary: Whether a live agent, given only this server's tools, completes generated tasks (LLM-judged, repeated for a success rate).

dimensions.title: Tool Reliability
dimensions.summary: Fraction of the agent's tool calls the server executed without error — a server-quality signal distinct from whether the agent finished the task.

findings.message: 9/43 agent tool calls returned an error

dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: Locate all Python script files (*.py) in the directory '/workspace/project' and read the file '/workspace/project/main.py' to determine the port number the server listens on.
results.rubric: The agent must call search_files with path '/workspace/project' and pattern '*.py', then call read_text_file for '/workspace/project/main.py'. The final response must accurately state the server port specified in main.py.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent failed to search or read files in '/workspace/project' due to tool errors and never determined the port number.

results.description: Check the allowed root directories using list_allowed_directories, then list the files in '/workspace/data' sorted by size using list_directory_with_sizes to identify the largest file in that folder.
results.rubric: The agent must call list_allowed_directories and list_directory_with_sizes with path '/workspace/data' and sortBy parameter set to size (or equivalent sorting option). The final response must correctly state the name and size of the largest file.
results.sample_reasoning: The tool call to list files in '/workspace/data' errored due to access restrictions, so the agent was unable to list the directory or identify the largest file.

results.description: Search for all PNG image files in '/workspace/assets' matching pattern '*.png', and then load '/workspace/assets/logo.png' using read_media_file to verify its MIME type.
results.rubric: The agent must invoke search_files with path '/workspace/assets' and pattern '*.png', then invoke read_media_file with path '/workspace/assets/logo.png'. The agent must confirm the file was returned as an image/png media content block.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent failed to search the specified path due to a tool error and never executed read_media_file to load the PNG image and verify its MIME type.
